title: feat(spec)!: a locale must be a BCP-47 tag — zh_CN, padded values and language names are refused
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbDHE1kjcgpLAAwZU2cx9frG)_
Fixes #25822

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## What changes

`LocaleSchema` (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`) was a bare `z.string()`. A translator or AI author who wrote `zh_CN`, a padded value or `not a locale!!` got a green save, and the strings were stored under a locale no session ever asks for. The resolvers fold case and nothing else, so those strings never rendered.

- **Schema refusal.** `LocaleSchema` now accepts only a tag-shaped value: a 2–8 letter language subtag, then hyphen-separated 1–8 letter-or-digit subtags. This is the same pattern `SYS_USER_LOCALE_TAG_PATTERN` uses for a user's own `locale` column. The refusal is one `invalid_format` issue whose message names the shape and the release. Case is not judged: `zh-cn` still parses, because every resolver folds case.
- **Data at rest.** ADR-0087 D2 conversion `translation-locale-tag-canonicalized` (retired from the load path from day one, `retiredAfter: '18.1.0'`, order 76) rewrites the two spellings that have one tag they can have meant: `_` as the separator, and surrounding whitespace. Any other value is left as stored and reported as a TODO. So is a bundle key that would land on a tag the entry already holds with different strings. An identical twin is merged.
- **D3 entry** `translation-locale-non-tag-refused` carries the judgment for `os migrate meta`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/25822-locale-tag-shape.md` (`@objectstack/spec` minor) with the FROM → TO mapping and both declaration lines.

## Every consumer of `LocaleSchema`, and whether it is in scope

| Site | In scope? | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| `TranslationItemSchema.locale` (metadata save door, `defineTranslation`) | yes | refused at `locale`; the card's reproduction |
| `TranslationBundleSchema` / `PlatformTranslationBundleSchema` map key (`defineTranslationBundle`, `stack.translations`) | yes | refused as `invalid_key` at the key; the error map surfaces the nested message |
| `TranslationConfigSchema` `defaultLocale` / `supportedLocales` / `fallbackLocale` | yes | refused at the value; the conversion covers `i18n.*` |
| `data/seed.zod.ts` `Seed.locale[]` | yes | refused at the value; the conversion covers `data[].locale[]` |
| `data/seed-loader.zod.ts` `SeedLoaderConfig.locale` | yes, by reach | a runtime request, not stored. Its one producer is `AppPlugin.resolveSeedLocale()`, which reads `i18n.defaultLocale`, itself narrowed above, and converted at artifact load (`convertArtifactAtLoad` runs over the definition) |
| `conversions/registry.ts` comments at the submitLabel and subCaption walks ("`LocaleSchema` is an open string") | no edit | still true in the sense they use it: the locale keys are an open set and cannot be enumerated, so judging the bundle structurally stays right |
| `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts` translation bundle walk | no edit | walks every key under the never-throws contract; unaffected by the shape |
| `ui/packages/app-shell/.../metadata-admin/clientValidation.ts` | no edit | its comment describes the bundle-vs-item contract, not the locale shape; the server door refuses, which is the contract |

## Mechanism assumptions, re-measured on `0c372288`

- **Zero non-canonical locales in non-test source**: holds. A `git grep` over `locale`/`defaultLocale`/`fallbackLocale` literals, `supportedLocales` arrays and underscore bundle keys across `packages/` and `examples/` finds none that parse through `LocaleSchema`. The non-tag hits are a user's `sys_user.locale`, an email-template locale and the i18n label resolver's inputs, none of which use this schema.
- **Syntax-only check fits**: holds (`shared/value-domain.zod.ts` records why a registry check was dropped).
- **Stored deployed rows**: cannot be measured from the repository. The conversion covers stored `translation` rows (`applyConversionsToStoredItem` reaches them through `STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS`) and built artifacts inside their declared-floor window.
- **Landing point**: as ordered, `translation.zod.ts` plus one MAJOR_18 conversion. No other producer needed a fix.

## Deviations from the claim's file surface

Two files outside `translation.zod.ts (+ tests), registry.ts, generated artefacts, one changeset`, each forced by a red test:

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.translation-locale-non-tag-refused.ts`, the D3 entry: `migrations.test.ts` reds "from protocol 18 on, every graduated D2 conversion is named by a D3 entry of its own step (ruling B)" without it (measured).
- `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`: one JOIN row. The pin reds every entry retired after the newest published stable release that has no row.

## Verification (head `3e367787`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, then `check:generated`: 14/14 artifacts up to date.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 722 files, 21903 tests passed.
- New pins in `translation.test.ts`: tags accepted, ten non-tags refused as `invalid_format` naming the release, refusal at the item, bundle key, platform bundle key and i18n config, and the conversion's TODOs and twin merge. The conversion fixture runs in `conversions.test.ts` (7 notices).
- Derived local gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 92/92 run, all exit 0. Five exited 3 (prerequisite not built) on the first pass and 0 after the dependency closure was built. `--ran` reconciliation: 92 derived, 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- Dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, after building the dogfood closure): VERDICT command-exit 1. Test Files 1 failed, 295 passed, 3 skipped (299); Tests 1 failed, 2522 passed, 18 skipped (2541). The one failure is not this diff's: `test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` > `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts` expects 3 occurrences of the `handleI18nRequest` control and reads 4. `69fa23d60` (#25956, already on `main`) added the fourth. This diff touches no runtime file.

## Acceptance notes

- Case-insensitive acceptance (`zh-cn`) is deliberate: the resolvers fold case (`resolveLocale` in core's memory i18n, the metadata-protocol seed loader), so refusing it would refuse a locale that works.
- A non-tag `i18n.defaultLocale` that reaches `AppPlugin` without passing `defineStack` and outside the artifact window now fails the boot-time `SeedLoaderRequestSchema.parse` loudly instead of filtering seeds on a locale no dataset can name.
